title: A Fixture Study of Policy-First Campus AI Routing
abstract: This deterministic engineering fixture uses the sample project objective to exercise SIGMA paper rendering. It contains no independently conducted investigation, workload measurement, university policy finding, or provider-price analysis. The figure is an illustrative proposal and does not describe an implemented MindRouter federation.
problem_framing: Universities may compare campus-local, approved frontier, hybrid and cooperative service models under sovereignty and budget constraints. This restates the sample question and is not an empirical finding.
methods: A mocked author response was validated and compiled by SIGMA with Tectonic. No live provider was contacted.

claims.statement: The saved project contains a research objective.
claims.reasoning: The objective is explicitly present in the project snapshot.

sections.heading: Fixture scope
paragraphs: This fixture tests a safe policy-first routing illustration; it makes no empirical claims about cost, performance, governance or federation.

sections.heading: Interpretation
paragraphs: The policy gate precedes any proposed external route. This diagram is a rendering test, not an architecture evaluation.

limitations: No Investigator/Skeptic research session or external sources were saved.
The architecture is illustrative and unmeasured.
open_obligations: Conduct and save substantive research before evaluating campus costs, quality or governance.
conclusions: This fixture verifies diagram rendering only; it does not answer the research question.
